description: This file defines the class 'pDraw' which provides various methods for drawing shapes, text, gradients, images, and other graphical elements on a PHP image resource. It includes constants for orientations, labels, and styles, and methods for drawing polygons, rectangles, circles, lines, text, gradients, and loading external images, primarily for chart rendering or graphic composition within the pChart library.

classes.name: pDraw
classes.description: A class providing a comprehensive set of drawing methods for rendering shapes, lines, text, gradients, and images on a PHP image resource, primarily used within the pChart graphics library.

methods.name: countDrawableSeries
methods.description: Returns the number of data series that are marked as drawable, excluding the abscissa.

methods.name: fixBoxCoordinates
methods.description: Ensures coordinates are correctly ordered to define a rectangle, returning min/max values.

methods.name: drawPolygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon shape with specified points and formatting options.

methods.name: drawRoundedRectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with rounded corners using specified radius and format.

methods.name: drawRoundedFilledRectangle
methods.description: Draws a filled rectangle with rounded corners, including optional shadow effects.

methods.name: drawRectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle outline with specified format.

methods.name: drawFilledRectangle
methods.description: Draws a filled rectangle shape with specified coloring and formatting options.

methods.name: drawCircle
methods.description: Draws the outline of a circle with specified center, size, and color.

methods.name: drawFilledCircle
methods.description: Draws a filled circle with specified center, radius, and color.

methods.name: drawText
methods.description: Renders text at specified coordinates with font, size, color, alignment, and optional shadow and background.

methods.name: drawGradientArea
methods.description: Fills a specified area with a gradient in vertical or horizontal direction.

methods.name: drawAntialiasPixel
methods.description: Draws an individual pixel with optional anti-aliasing effects.

methods.name: drawAlphaPixel
methods.description: Sets a pixel with semi-transparency, considering masking and shadow.

methods.name: convertAlpha
methods.description: Converts a transparency value to a color alpha level.

methods.name: allocateColor
methods.description: Allocates a color with transparency to the image resource.

methods.name: drawFromPNG
methods.description: Loads a PNG file and draws it onto the current picture at specified position.

methods.name: drawFromGIF
methods.description: Loads a GIF file and draws it onto the current picture.

methods.name: drawFromJPG
methods.description: Loads a JPEG file and draws it onto the current picture.

methods.name: getPicInfo
methods.description: Retrieves size and mime type information about an external image file.

methods.name: drawFromPicture
methods.description: Loads an external image of specified type and overlays it onto the current picture.

methods.name: drawArrow
methods.description: Draws an arrow from one point to another with specified formatting.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Calculates the angle in degrees between two points.

methods.name: drawBezier
methods.description: Draws a bezier curve with control points between two points.

methods.name: drawLine
methods.description: Draws a line between two points, with support for line width and style.

methods.name: drawFilledStepChart
methods.description: Draws a filled step chart based on dataset, supporting various formatting options and rendering modes.

methods.name: drawAreaChart
methods.description: Draws an area chart from dataset series with options for thresholds, gradient fills, labels, and background.

methods.name: drawBarChart
methods.description: Draws a bar chart with options for colors, rounding, gradients, shadows, and labels.

methods.name: drawStackedBarChart
methods.description: Draws a stacked bar chart, stacking series and handling various visual formatting options.

methods.name: drawStackedAreaChart
methods.description: Draws a stacked area chart, using series offsets and gradient fills, supporting multiple orientations and labels.

methods.name: drawBestFit
methods.description: Draws a line of best fit for a series, computing linear regression and plotting the regression line.

methods.name: writeLabel
methods.description: Writes labels for series or axes, supports different formats, overlays, and label positioning.

methods.name: drawLabelBox
methods.description: Draws a label box with title, captions, styling options, and gradient background.

methods.name: drawShape
methods.description: Draws various geometric shapes (circle, square, triangle, diamond) with options for borders and fills.

methods.name: drawPolygonChart
methods.description: Draws a polygon chart with options for gradient fill, borders, and segment simplification.

methods.name: getAbscissaMargin
methods.description: Returns the margin for the abscissa axis based on dataset properties.
